what_changed: FMVSS 108 amended to permit adaptive driving beam (S9.4.1.6 Option 2): system must detect malfunctions (incl. sensor obstruction), fall back to manual mode with a visible driver warning, give lower beam only below 32 km/h, and switch only between lower/upper/ADB in automatic mode
note: Optional (permissive) function, but where fitted it requires forward sensing, malfunction detection and segmented-beam control; FR 2024-12-30 (89 FR 106365) denied petitions, no amendment

what_changed: Reversing lamps with more than one light source: on failure of one light source either minimum intensity is kept or a signal for activation of a failure tell-tale (R48 para. 6.4.8) must be produced (new para. 6.1.6)
note: Optional alternative (failure signal) adopted in the GRE multi-light-source package; existing lamps can keep option (a)

what_changed: New UN Regulation on road illumination devices (consolidating headlamp, AFS, front fog and cornering lamp regulations): AFS control-signal modes, bending-mode and failure provisions (automatic fallback to passing beam), failure signal for the R48 tell-tale
note: First adoption in window; content largely carried over from R98/R112/R113/R119/R123 (device regulations frozen by their 2019 series); EIF date as stated in ECE/TRANS/WP.29/2019/125

what_changed: 01 series: performance-based rewrite; new adaptive driving-beam class for L3 vehicles and Driver Assistance Projection as part of ADB/passing beam (with R48/R53 parallel amendments); approvals to earlier series first issued after 2026-09-01 need not be accepted
note: What changed read from the base documents ECE/TRANS/WP.29/GRE/2021/14, GRE/2021/18 and GRE/2020/13/Rev.1 (justifications); approvals first issued before 2026-09-01 stay accepted

what_changed: Supplement 3 to 01 series: scope extended to AFS for L3 vehicles (ADB for L3 clarified), with system documentation showing compliance with the R53 adaptive-lighting control and signal-status provisions
note: Optional new adaptive function for motorcycles

what_changed: Supplement 5 to 01 series: failure signal for functions made of several light-emitting elements, with selectable detection criteria (element out, intensity below 80 %, flux change above 5 %, more than 5 % of elements out, approved light source out); bending-mode failure fallback reworded
note: Monitor definition; the applicant selects the criterion

what_changed: Direction indicators of L-category vehicles: flash may be produced by sequential activation of light sources under stated conditions (inboard-to-outboard progression, all segments lit within 200 ms of ON-cycle start, remain lit to end of cycle)
Sequential direction-indicator conditions revised (single uninterrupted signal, max 50 mm gaps, no vertical oscillation); approvals from 2018-09-01 only to the amended conditions
note: AC.1 adopted ECE/TRANS/WP.29/2017/80 and 2017/81 together as Supplement 20 (report ECE/TRANS/WP.29/1131); 2017/80 itself (light-source restriction) is not ECU-reaching

what_changed: Rear fog lamps with more than one light source: on failure of one light source either minimum intensity is kept or a signal for activation of a failure tell-tale (R48 para. 6.11.8) must be produced
note: Optional alternative in the March 2017 GRE multi-light-source package (same provision as R23-00-S21)
